name: Heightmap Terrain
definition: A terrain storage method where only the height component is stored for each vertex, typically in a 2D texture, with position and resolution provided once for the whole quad. Landscape geometry is generated each frame using a geometry shader or hardware tessellation.
summary: Heightmap terrain defines landscape geometry via a 2D texture storing single height values per coordinate, enabling efficient rendering of continuous outdoor environments while excluding overhangs or caves.
